# ExampleProj

ExampleProj is a minimal cross-compiler toolchain wrapper. It exists because the upstream build scripts assume a POSIX host and silently produce broken binaries elsewhere.

## Getting started

Run `./configure --host=x86_64-w64-mingw32` and then `make`. The [installation page](Installation) covers the prerequisites in detail.

## Known issues

Parallel builds above `-j8` intermittently fail on case-insensitive filesystems.
